definitions: To be able to enter or be contained within a space.
To be suitable for or become part of a group, system, or plan.
To find time for something or someone in one's schedule.
examples: The new sofa won't fit into the living room.
He struggled to fit into the new school environment.
I'll try to fit into my busy schedule a quick call.
pastTenses: fit into (past simple), fitted into (past perfect)
